comment: Security boundary for delegated agents. Detected: Python (pyproject) (pyproject.toml), scripts in scripts/.
This file REPLACES the harness built-in allowlist; it does not extend it.
Generated by ~/.claude/bin/init-agent-harness.py as a STARTING POINT.
allowed_cmds: argv prefix rules. Each element is an fnmatch pattern matched
element-wise over the first N argv entries, with NO shell -- so pipes, globs,
chaining and substitution are impossible. Matching is by prefix, so
['git','status'] also permits 'git status --short'. Path-shaped arguments are
rejected if absolute or containing a '..' segment, so a pattern rule cannot
be walked out of the repo.
WIDENING: these defaults are read-only plus the obvious test runner. Adding a
command that mutates a real artifact (a workbook, a database, a deployment) is
a deliberate decision, because run_command ALWAYS executes against the real
on-disk tree -- even in the harness default staged write mode, which holds
back write_file/replace_in_file only, never command side effects.

NEVER add: python -c / node -e (arbitrary code execution; dissolves the boundary); git push / git commit (publishes or rewrites history from inside an agent loop); any shell (bash, sh, powershell, cmd) (re-introduces pipes, chaining and globs); rm / del / Remove-Item (an agent does not need to delete outside its patch).
skip_dirs: pruned from grep and list_dir for search hygiene. NOT access
control -- read_file still reaches inside, deliberately. Keep .claude here or
a run will grep its own transcripts and worktree copies.
NARROWED 2026-09-24 from the generated defaults:
REMOVED ['python','scripts/*'] -- it admits 'python scripts/deploy_engine.py
--apply', which atomically replaces the SHARED machine-wide engine at
~/.claude/bin/delegate.py that every repo's agents run on, and
scripts/migrate_existing.py, which forwards to 'agent-control migrate' and can
apply live migration. AGENTS.md makes both operator-gated. run_command runs
against the real tree in every mode, so no agent may reach either script.
scripts/verify_reconciliation.py reads live accounting state under
~/.claude/agent-control, which no delegated task needs.
REMOVED ['node','scripts/*'] -- there are no node scripts in scripts/.
REMOVED ['ruff','check'] -- ruff is not installed on this machine.
ADDED ['node','--test','tests/js/*'] -- the vanilla dashboard helpers have their
own node test suite (README). The slot-3 pattern pins the target to tests/js/.
ADDED ['python','-u','tools/agent-harness/*'] -- rules match argv POSITIONALLY,
so the bare rule does not admit the '-u' form (Projectb lesson, 2026-09-21).
Every test injects temporary paths (AGENTS.md), so python -m pytest does not
touch live accounting state. py_compile compiles WITHOUT importing or executing.
NOTE, not a policy matter: delegate.py already bounds every run_command at
CMD_TIMEOUT = 600s. Do not write briefs that ask an agent to prefix 'timeout'.
